audience: ecommerce sellers and accountants who review Amazon, Shopify and PayPal sales data in A2X

useCases.title: Check which sales accounts are connected
useCases.text: List the A2X organizations your token can access. Then list the sales accounts your token can access, such as Amazon, Shopify or PayPal.

useCases.title: Review the SKU costs used for cost of goods
useCases.text: List the latest SKU cost files of an account, then read the costs in one file. Compare them with the product catalog.

useCases.title: Create a monthly sales export as CSV
useCases.text: Create a CSV export for one account and one calendar month, such as sales by GL account and type. Then read its rows. The file is kept for 15 days.

useCases.title: Query subledger totals for a period
useCases.text: Read the fields of a subledger topic and estimate how much data a query scans. Then run the read-only query for the totals you need. The subledger API must be enabled for the organization.
